## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "Deterministic Hazard Assessment"`

```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
# MCE products carry no TR and use their own fractile set: clear pins
# left in the global env by earlier slides before any child knits.
rm(list = intersect(c("TR.target", "p.target"), ls()))
SiteID.target <- .currentTarget("siteID.target")
ID.target <- sort(unique(MCETable[
  !ID %in% c("MCE", "max", "min") & !grepl("\\.(site|oq|max)$", ID),
  ID
]))
if (!length(SiteID.target)) SiteID.target <- siteID.gmdp[[1L]]
siteID.target <- SiteID.target
Vs30.target <- 760
.IDS <- c(ID.target, "MCE")
.SITE <- if (length(siteID.target) == 1L) tolower(siteID.target) else NULL
.P.curves <- c("0.84", "0.90", "0.95", "mean")
.P.tables <- c("0.84", "0.90", "0.95", "mean")
```

:::{.panel-tabset .full-width}

### Median response spectra

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_fig/GMPE.PSA.qmd",
  stem = paste(c(.SITE, "gmm-psa"), collapse = "-"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(siteID.target = siteID.target),
  root = root
)
```

### MCE

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_fig/MCE.UHS.qmd",
  stem = paste(c(.SITE, "mce", "hazard-spectrum"), collapse = "-"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(
    ID.target = "MCE",
    siteID.target = siteID.target,
    p.target = .P.curves,
    Sa.log = TRUE
  ),
  root = root
)
```

### Summary

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_tbl/MCE.PGA.qmd",
  stem = paste(c(.SITE, "mce-pga"), collapse = "-"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(
    ID.target = .IDS,
    siteID.target = siteID.target,
    p.target = .P.tables
  ),
  root = root
)
```

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "ID.target", "siteID.target", "Vs30.target", ".SITE", ".IDS",
  ".P.curves", ".P.tables", "p.target", "TRT.text", ".mceBullet"
), ls()))
siteID.target <- SiteID.target
rm(SiteID.target)
```
